meta.name: Hartenjagen
meta.tagline: Dutch Hearts for 4 or 5, at a 1970s kitchen table.

rules.deck: 32 cards, 7 to ace. With 4 players everyone gets 8. With 5 everyone gets 6, and the 2 left over lie face down as the stok: whoever takes the first trick takes the stok too.
rules.points: Every heart is 1 point, the queen of spades 5, the jack of clubs 2: 15 a hand. Follow suit if you can; the highest card of the suit led takes the trick.
rules.scoring: Scores count up until someone reaches 50. From the next hand on they count down, and the first to reach 0 wins.
rules.allPoints: Take all 15 in one hand and you score nothing; everyone else gets the 15.

table.watching: You're watching this game. You'll play in the next one.
